dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: trailing edge exhibits a continuous concave spline curve with a smooth transition from the dorsal ridge to the apex
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: rounded geometry with a moderate pixel radius at the highest morphological point
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: linear anterior margin oriented at approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal longitudinal axis
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: approximately 1:1 ratio between the maximum pixel base width and vertical height

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: broad, low-eccentricity convex arc along the anterior-dorsal boundary
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: short rostrum extension with high thickness-to-length ratio relative to melon volume
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: obtuse interior angle at the transition point between the melon slope and the rostrum

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: cluster of high-luminance white irregular marks or lesions located posterior to the eye and along the mid-dorsal flank
other_distinctive_markers: uniform high-intensity cyan/teal luminosity across the entire visible morphological surface
